title: Your Way
slide_intent: Bind a short promise to an identifiable signature so the closing message remains attributable to the brand.
strategic_value: A consistent Your Way end lockup can link Burger King’s customization promise to its logo.
demonstration: The pale Your Way wordmark appears alone above a pale horizontal combination with the burger logo on brown.
practical_value: Use the supplied logo combination in Mayo Egg White at the end of television commercials.

content_islands.name: Usage restriction
content_islands.spec: Place the fixed-form and television-ending instructions at left.

content_islands.name: Phrase specimen
content_islands.spec: Show the large Your Way wordmark at upper right.

content_islands.name: Logo lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the logo and phrase together beneath, with the logo to the left.

reference_purposes.Expression: Both specimens use the heavy rounded phrase in a pale-on-brown treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The page supplies the television-ending logo combination.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Your Way is used only locked up with the logo at the end of television commercials, in Mayo Egg White.

ingredient.name: Your Way television end lockup
ingredient.role: Attach the promise to the brand at the commercial’s close.
ingredient.application: Use the supplied logo-and-phrase configuration in Mayo Egg White.
ingredient.scope: Historical partner guide; restricted to television-commercial endings. The standalone specimen does not authorize standalone deployment.
